exposure: First-child older siblings whose birth/gestation led to NFN enrollment
Second children of families who were screened as eligible for NFN, but not offered the program
Non-NFN second children in a propensity-score-matched group
cohort: Second-born children (n=9500) in a statewide home visiting program (Nurturing Families Network [NFN]) linked to birth certificate data
finding: This study will examine the impact of a home visiting program on birth outcomes for second-born children, including birth spacing, prenatal care, cesarean section rates, gestational age, and birth weight.
mod_finding: This study will examine the association between home visiting program participation for first-time mothers and cesarean section rates in subsequent births.
